subject: MdeModulePkg/NvmExpressDxe: Clear NSID to 0 for sanitize command
reasons: Single targeted fix in one function: removes assignment of NamespaceId from Device->NamespaceId and reassigns it to 0 specifically before the Sanitize NVMe command.
This is a spec compliance fix at one specific call site — the change requires understanding which NVMe commands use NSID and which do not.
No repetitive pattern across multiple files or functions; other NVMe commands legitimately use the namespace ID.
Case-by-case reasoning is required to determine which commands need NSID cleared — not suitable for Coccinelle.
